title: Leslyn Lewis demands answers on ‘safeguards’ in new euthanasia bill
description: OTTAWA ( LifeSiteNews ) — Pro-life Conservative MP Leslyn Lewis demanded that the ruling Liberal government explain what safeguards will be put in place for its new euthanasia bill that allows people to be euthanized without their consent. “Who makes those decisions whether a person can live or die at that particular time when they do not have the capacity to do that?” she asked MPs during a recent House of Commons debate. … Liberal Justice Minister Sean Fraser, who introduced Bill C-41, says that it permanently blocks euthanasia, or so-called “medical assistance in dying” (MAiD), for those with mental illness. However, CLC warned that it allows euthanasia to continue, leaving only doctors and nurses as a purported check and balance. As LifeSiteNews reported , on October 7, the federal government paused a planned expansion of allowing euthanasia to those with mental illness as the sole cause. Still, it then said that it would allow assisted suicide by advance request. On the same day, it voted against Conservative Bill C-218, which would have banned the practice outright. Euthanasia in Canada has become prevalent . Recent statistics show that the nation recorded more deaths by euthanasia than murders by guns in the United States in 2024.

title: Baby saved from abortion after dad drives by pro-life sign, priest says
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) – A Canadian Catholic priest has shared the positive news that an unborn child was saved from an abortion after the child’s father saw a Life Chain pro-life witness on the side of the road and had a change of heart. Campaign Life Coalition (CLC) shared the “good news” of the baby being saved, after recounting a story from Fr. Brenton Cordeiro, pastor of St. Timothy’s Catholic church in Toronto. … According to CLC, since abortion became legal in Canada in 1969, nearly five million preborn children have “been erased” by the deadly practice. The sad reality is that abortion has become more common in Canada. There were 368,928 babies born in Canada from 2024 to 2025, a number that would be much greater if not for abortion. In 2022, 97,211 Canadian babies were killed by abortion. Similarly, reports from 2018 indicated that 766 babies were born alive and presumably left to die after late-term abortions in Canada between 2013 and 2018.

title: Liberal author claims Catholics don’t ‘seriously believe’ in Real Presence
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. ( LifeSiteNews ) — Author Joyce Carol Oates has mocked the Catholic doctrine on transubstantiation and claimed that author Flannery O’Connor did not believe in the Real Presence. … Ulrich Lehner, a Catholic professor at Notre Dame University, told Oates, “I would be embarrassed if I spoke so uninformed.” Other users on X added a “community note,” used to correct false claims on the platform or offer additional context. The note states: “Flannery O’Connor did not believe the Eucharist was merely ‘symbolic’ or ‘metaphorical,’ contrary to Oates’ claim. O’Connor repeatedly stated the Catholic belief that although the wafer has the physical qualities (‘accidents’) of bread, its true substance is Jesus Christ.” O’Connor famously said: “Well, if it’s a symbol, to hell with it!” The novelist was an outspoken defender of Christ’s Real Presence in the Eucharist.
